# Peak Property Performance

> Peak Property Performance® is a 2026 Amazon Best Seller published by Fast Company Press, authored by Bill Douglas (CEO, OpticWise), Drew Hall, and Ryan R. Goble. It introduces the 5C™ Framework (Clarify, Connect, Collect, Coordinate, Control) — a vendor-agnostic strategy for CRE owners, asset managers, and operators to own their data and digital infrastructure, grow NOI, and build AI readiness without vendor lock-in. The site also hosts a weekly podcast and free operator resources.

Peak Property Performance® is a program of [OpticWise](https://opticwise.com), headquartered in Golden, Colorado.

## Core Pages

- [The Book](https://peakpropertyperformance.com/book): 2026 Amazon Best Seller from Fast Company Press. Authors: Bill Douglas, Drew Hall, Ryan R. Goble. Covers data ownership, AI readiness, and NOI growth for commercial real estate.
- [The 5C™ Framework](https://peakpropertyperformance.com/5c-framework): The five-play strategy — Clarify, Connect, Collect, Coordinate, Control — that turns fragmented property data into compounding portfolio intelligence.
- [The Podcast](https://peakpropertyperformance.com/podcast): Weekly conversations with CRE owners, operators, and industry leaders. Hosted by Bill Douglas and Drew Hall. Available on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, YouTube, iHeart, and RSS.
- [About the Authors](https://peakpropertyperformance.com/about): Bill Douglas (CEO, OpticWise), Drew Hall, and Ryan R. Goble — combined decades of CRE technology operations across multifamily, office, mixed-use, and hospitality.
- [FAQ](https://peakpropertyperformance.com/faq): 20 questions and answers about the book, podcast, 5C™ Framework, PPP Review, and resources.

## By Role

- [For CRE Owners](https://peakpropertyperformance.com/for-owners): How the 5C™ Framework applies to owners — data ownership, vendor control gaps, and recoverable NOI.
- [For Asset Managers](https://peakpropertyperformance.com/for-asset-managers): Investor-grade data insights for capital allocation, refinance timing, and portfolio-wide reporting.
- [For Property Managers](https://peakpropertyperformance.com/for-property-managers): Replacing reactive vendor coordination with a systemic, owner-controlled view of building operations.
- [For IT Managers](https://peakpropertyperformance.com/for-it-managers): One owner-controlled connectivity standard with real governance, eliminating shadow networks across portfolios.

## Resources & Tools

- [Free Downloads](https://peakpropertyperformance.com/resources): 5C™ Quick-Start Worksheet, Vendor Contract Audit, PPP Glossary, and more.
- [PPP Glossary](https://peakpropertyperformance.com/glossary): 42 CRE data and digital infrastructure terms defined in plain language.
- [Vendor Contract Audit](https://peakpropertyperformance.com/vendor-contract-audit): Free 12-question diagnostic scoring vendor lock-in risk in CRE contracts.
- [Request a PPP Review](https://peakpropertyperformance.com/ppp-review): Complimentary 45-minute CRE data and digital infrastructure review for one building. Delivers a Property Data Map, Control Gap Analysis, and top 3 actionable plays.
- [Be on the Show](https://peakpropertyperformance.com/be-on-the-show): Apply to be a guest on the PPP Podcast. Open to CRE operators, PropTech founders, capital allocators, and category experts.
